_what: VolleyTalk community poll -- MANUALLY IMPORTED, never scraped.
_policy: VolleyTalk is a community/committee reference and a THIRD-PARTY source.
Nothing here is fetched, logged into, posted to, or automated in any way.
scripts/.claude hook no_scrape.py blocks volleyballmag and the other named
hosts; VolleyTalk is not crawled by any script in this repo and there is no
code path that reads this file into a rating, a projection, POWER, Resume,
Digby, or the private ballot. It is display-only, and a guard asserts that.
To import a poll: add an object to `polls` by hand, with the thread URL, the
date it was published, the date it says it covers, and the ranked teams.
Team names must match the hub's own spelling (reconcile_2025.norm handles
